source: Scripted headless recording of a local mock notes app 'Notely'; no audio track

claims.text: Saving a note shows a confirmation.
claims.note: 'Saved ✓' toast visible only 9.2–9.9, strictly between the 9 s and 10 s samples. Tests transient events: with 1 fps sampling a miss here is a known pipeline limit, not a labelling error.

claims.text: Search filters the notes list as you type.
claims.note: Typing 'meeting' from 14.0; the list goes from '5 of 5 notes' to '2 of 5 notes' by 15.6 and stays filtered.

claims.text: Notes sync across all your devices.
claims.note: On-screen caption only (23.0–30.0); there is no narration and nothing demonstrates syncing.

claims.text: Notes can be shared via a public link.
